input.quote: In addition, in the event that Array terminates this Agreement for Ono's breach pursuant to Section 13.3 during the [ * ], or Ono exercises its right to terminate this Agreement \"at will\" pursuant to Section 13.2 during the Initial Royalty Term, then neither Ono nor its Affiliates shall Commercialize a Competing Product or grant the right to a licensee or distributor to Commercialize a Competing Product in the Ono Territory prior to the [ * ] anniversary of the date such termination takes effect.
input.rationale: Section 8.2 imposes a Competing Product restriction on us (Ono). The in-term limb is acceptable: it is mutual (Array and its Controlled Affiliates are equally bound), limited to the Ono Territory (Japan and Korea), confined to Commercialization only (leaving our internal Development free), tied to defined compound classes other than Binimetinib/Encorafenib rather than "any competing business", and paired with a benefit to us (the royalty period ends if Array commercializes a Competing Product). That limb sits within the fallback and we do not redline it; we note only that the period is redacted and should be confirmed as ending with the term. The second limb, however, is a one-sided post-termination non-compete on us of unspecified ([ * ]) duration with no carve-out for internal development or acquired products. That fails the fallback's "during the term only, capped at 12 months, with a carve-out for internal development and acquisitions" and risks walk-away territory if the redacted anniversary exceeds 12 months. Given the reciprocal in-term bargain, we take the fallback rather than preferred: cap the tail at twelve (12) months and add carve-outs for internal research/Development and products acquired through M&A.

proposal.summary: Cap the post-termination Competing Product restriction on Ono at 12 months and add carve-outs for internal development and acquired products.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept an open-ended post-termination restriction on the products we may commercialize, so we have capped the tail at twelve (12) months and carved out our internal research/development and products acquired via M&A. We are comfortable leaving the mutual in-term exclusivity in Section 8.2 as drafted.

ops.oldText: prior to the [ * ] anniversary of the date such termination takes effect.
ops.newText: for a period of twelve (12) months following the date such termination takes effect; provided that such restriction shall not apply to (i) any internal research or Development activities of Ono or its Affiliates, or (ii) any product Controlled by a Third Party that is acquired by Ono or any of its Affiliates by means of a merger, acquisition or similar transaction.
